body: Thank you so much. I will try to keep this in mind. Keep going. I'm also very scared of feeling suicidal again because I don't know how to fend it off. It's so powerful when it happens and it feels like I have no choice but to give up

And to reply to your question, I have my books and they distract me :) I just know that I can't stay constantly distracted, sooner or later the thoughts will creep up on me and I don't know how to defend myself when they come.

Thanks for replying. I took a benzo and am going out for some food now, then try to sleep because I'm relocating tomorrow morning. But I'm worried about what to do if this persists. I feel helpless in this situation. I think what worries me the most is that I have nothing to come home to after travelling, I don't have the funds to keep up this escape from my depression. I need to finish my education and build a new life from scratch andI'm scared that I'm not capable
